assignments_active_user_group_role_uidx.name: assignments_active_user_group_role_uidx
assignments_active_user_group_role_uidx.where: "assignments"."effective_to" IS NULL AND "assignments"."scope_type" = 'group' AND "assignments"."user_id" IS NOT NULL

assignments_active_user_care_role_uidx.name: assignments_active_user_care_role_uidx
assignments_active_user_care_role_uidx.where: "assignments"."effective_to" IS NULL AND "assignments"."scope_type" = 'care' AND "assignments"."user_id" IS NOT NULL

assignments_active_user_body_role_uidx.name: assignments_active_user_body_role_uidx
assignments_active_user_body_role_uidx.where: "assignments"."effective_to" IS NULL AND "assignments"."scope_type" = 'body' AND "assignments"."user_id" IS NOT NULL

assignments_steward_identity_chk.name: assignments_steward_identity_chk
assignments_steward_identity_chk.value: "assignments"."user_id" IS NOT NULL OR "assignments"."steward_member_id" IS NOT NULL OR ("assignments"."steward_display_name" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim("assignments"."steward_display_name")) > 0)

assignments_scope_chk.name: assignments_scope_chk
assignments_scope_chk.value: ("assignments"."scope_type" = 'body' AND "assignments"."body_id" IS NOT NULL AND "assignments"."care_id" IS NULL AND "assignments"."group_id" IS NULL) OR ("assignments"."scope_type" = 'care' AND "assignments"."care_id" IS NOT NULL AND "assignments"."body_id" IS NULL AND "assignments"."group_id" IS NULL) OR ("assignments"."scope_type" = 'group' AND "assignments"."group_id" IS NOT NULL AND "assignments"."body_id" IS NULL AND "assignments"."care_id" IS NULL)

assignments_scope_role_match_chk.name: assignments_scope_role_match_chk
assignments_scope_role_match_chk.value: ("assignments"."scope_type" = 'body' AND "assignments"."role_type" = 'body_leader') OR ("assignments"."scope_type" = 'care' AND "assignments"."role_type" IN ('care_leader', 'other_authorized')) OR ("assignments"."scope_type" = 'group' AND "assignments"."role_type" IN ('care_leader', 'coordinator', 'group_leader', 'other_authorized'))

region.name: region
region.default: 'ภาคตะวันออกเฉียงเหนือ'

candidate_loc_target_chk.name: candidate_loc_target_chk
candidate_loc_target_chk.value: "candidate_location_matches"."group_id" IS NOT NULL OR "candidate_location_matches"."staging_group_id" IS NOT NULL

groups_coords_pair_chk.name: groups_coords_pair_chk
groups_coords_pair_chk.value: ("house_mission_groups"."latitude" IS NULL AND "house_mission_groups"."longitude" IS NULL) OR ("house_mission_groups"."latitude" BETWEEN -90 AND 90 AND "house_mission_groups"."longitude" BETWEEN -180 AND 180)

members_identity_chk.name: members_identity_chk
members_identity_chk.value: "members"."full_name" IS NOT NULL OR "members"."nickname" IS NOT NULL

body_name_snapshot.name: body_name_snapshot
body_name_snapshot.default: 'รอจัดสรรบอดี้'

wr_no_self_approval_chk.name: wr_no_self_approval_chk
wr_no_self_approval_chk.value: "weekly_reports"."approved_by_user_id" IS NULL OR "weekly_reports"."submitted_by_user_id" IS NULL OR "weekly_reports"."approved_by_user_id" <> "weekly_reports"."submitted_by_user_id"

wr_sequential_review_chk.name: wr_sequential_review_chk
wr_sequential_review_chk.value: "weekly_reports"."status" <> 'approved' OR "weekly_reports"."requires_supervisor_review" = false OR "weekly_reports"."supervisor_reviewed_at" IS NOT NULL

wr_approved_fields_chk.name: wr_approved_fields_chk
wr_approved_fields_chk.value: ("weekly_reports"."status" = 'approved' AND "weekly_reports"."approved_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "weekly_reports"."approved_at" IS NOT NULL AND "weekly_reports"."is_blocked" = false) OR "weekly_reports"."status" <> 'approved'

wr_not_held_reason_chk.name: wr_not_held_reason_chk
wr_not_held_reason_chk.value: "weekly_reports"."status" = 'draft' OR "weekly_reports"."meeting_held" = true OR ("weekly_reports"."not_held_reason" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim("weekly_reports"."not_held_reason")) > 0)
